pred_texts: Instruct: Get a large pan and add two tablespoons of olive oil.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Get a medium sized shallot.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Now cut the shallots into medium-sized slices.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Get 100 grams of fresh spinach and remove the stems. Rinse and chop it into small pieces.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Get about 250 grams of firm tofu and chop it into small cubes.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Now switch on the stove with the pan. Set the heat to medium.
Feedback: Not yet, let's focus on the stove. Make sure it's set to medium heat.
Instruct: Now add sliced shallots to the pan and cook until they are soft and translucent for about three to five minutes. Grab a spatula and give it a little bit of a stir.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Now add the tofu and stir, give it a nice stir.
Feedback: Not yet, you need to stir the vegetables and tofu together.
Instruct: Now sauté the tofu for two minutes, stirring consistently with a spatula.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Now add the chopped spinach to the pan. Spread it evenly in the pan.
Feedback: Not yet, you've just added the spinach. Now, stir the vegetables to combine everything.
Instruct: Now season. Add one teaspoon of coriander powder, one teaspoon of cumin powder and some salt per taste. You can also add some turmeric powder to this per taste.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Now stir everything together such that the spices are well mixed.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Now cook until the spinach is fully wilted and tender and the tofu is heated through, about one to two minutes in total.
Success: Step complete.
